meta.name: baoyu-electron-extract
meta.description: Extracts resources and JavaScript from any installed Electron app (`.asar` bundle), restoring original sources from `.js.map` files when available or formatting minified code with Prettier otherwise. Use when user wants to "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", "get the source code of <app>", "inspect app.asar", "看 Electron 应用源码", "提取 .asar", or asks how a desktop Electron app is built. Skips `node_modules` and supports both macOS and Windows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 它会拆开已安装的 Electron 应用，导出其中的资源和 JavaScript。若包内带源码映射(.js.map)，就尽量还原成原始源码；否则把压缩后的代码整理成可读形式。始终跳过 node_modules。
howto.when: 当用户想查看已安装的 Electron 应用的内部结构、检查其打包代码，或提出提取 Electron 应用等类似请求时。

howto.what_en: It extracts an installed Electron app's resources and JS bundle from app.asar. When .js.map files embed original sources, it rebuilds them; otherwise it reformats minified code with Prettier. Always skips node_modules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to inspect an installed Electron app, look inside its bundle, or asks to extract an Electron app.

say_en.note: Auto-discovers the app; restores only if maps exist.
Directly extracts from the given file.
